subject: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@optimatrade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptimaTrade SRE <sre@optimatrade.com>, contracts@optimatrade.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill

Hi Neha + team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OptimaTrade is close to finalizing the commercial terms, but before we lock in the hosted SLA we need a narrow operational accommodation for our high-frequency end-of-day bunting periods.

Observations: during market close (17:30–18:00 ET) our throughput spikes ~6–8x for ~10–12 minutes; that creates transient p95 latency shifts even though p50 remains within target. Our legal/procurement team is asking for a short probation window where a slightly relaxed p95 measurement will be tolerated while we onboard burst-mitigation features.

Request: can Redwood provisionally accept a 30-day probation that:
 - treats two 12-minute daily windows (17:25–17:37 ET, 17:45–17:57 ET) as temporary burst windows for OptimaTrade only, allowing p95 to be measured with a weighted window (exclude top 1% of per-minute buckets for those windows),
 - requires OptimaTrade to provide request-sample logs and a mutual action plan within 5 business days,
 - includes an evidence/backfill run after 30 days to revert or formalize adjustments.

I've attached a short CSV with sample timestamps and a one-page ops note (optimatrade-request-sample.csv). Happy to hop on a call.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering
OptimaTrade

Attachment: optimatrade-request-sample.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@optimatrade.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for including the sample.

High level: we are sympathetic to workload-driven bursts and have operational patterns to handle them, but we need a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and objective evidence to put any temporary measurement exception in place. Proposed next steps:

1) Acceptance-in-principle for a 30-day probationary window contingent on delivery of the MAP + sample data within 5 business days.
2) Redwood will define the exact measurement rule for the probation (we propose: p50 target unchanged; p95 measured with a transient-bucket carveout limited to two 12-min daily windows and excluding the top 1% minute-level buckets in those windows).
3) Karthik will outline immediate mitigations you can enable (routing tiering, request headers for cache-affinity, request size analysis) that should reduce p95 tail.
4) After 30 days we will run an evidence backfill and propose either: (a) revert to standard SLOs, or (b) codify a permanent amendment if the MAP shows sustained severity.

Lauren — can you confirm how this maps to the term sheet/credits? We should also capture any potential service credits or price adjustments should SLO drift persist beyond probation.

If that sounds workable I can schedule a 30-min technical sync tomorrow with Karthik + your SRE.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@optimatrade.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill

Alex — quick technical note ahead of the sync.

We reviewed the sample and these are pragmatic, non-invasive steps you can implement immediately that should materially reduce p95 during the close bursts:

- Static routing by request-type: tag heavy backtests/large-batch requests with a header so we can route them to a dedicated pool (reduces noisy neighbor impact).
- Short-lived prefix cache: if you have repeated prefix patterns in the 2 windows, enabling a 30–120s KV cache with sticky affinity will drop tail times.
- Adaptive batching cap: limit batch sizes during the identified minutes to keep latency bounded; Redwood runtime supports dynamic per-customer batching overrides.

Operational metrics we need for evidence/backfill: 1-min QPS, per-request size distribution, token counts, and percentile time series (1-min resolution) for the 30-day window. The sample CSV is helpful — please include a 24-hour representative day plus two worst-case days.

I can run a short canary configuration for you from our side once we get the MAP and logs.

— Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex@optimatrade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: OptimaTrade SRE <sre@optimatrade.com>, contracts@optimatrade.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill

Neha / Karthik — thanks, this is exactly the sort of path we had in mind.

I attached:
 - optimatrade-request-sample.csv: 24hr representative day + two peak days (timestamps + request type + token count)
 - OTP-mutual-action-plan-v1.docx: MAP draft with owner names and rollback criteria
 - slo-probation-draft.pdf: short agreement language for the 30-day window (for contracts to review)

We agree to the MAP timeline and can send the additional 1-min granularity metrics by EOD Friday.

One question from our SRE: can Redwood confirm whether the probationary measurement will be visible in the Console (per-route percentile charts) in near-real time for us to monitor? Visibility is essential — if we can't monitor we would need a stronger credit/price buffer.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachment(s): optimatrade-request-sample.csv, OTP-mutual-action-plan-v1.docx, slo-probation-draft.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@optimatrade.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@optimatrade.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OptimaTrade: request for p50/p95 probation + burst evidence/backfill

Alex — looping in Contracts and confirming commercial posture. Short summary and what we'll put in the probation addendum:

1) Term: 30-day probation starting when MAP + 1-min metrics are received and we've applied the canary mitigations.
2) Measurement: p50 target unchanged (no carveout). For p95, Redwood will apply a temporary measurement rule scoped to the two supplied 12-minute windows; the rule excludes the top 1% minute-level buckets within those windows for the probation period only.
3) Visibility: Redwood Console will surface a parallel "probationary p95" time series and the raw minute-level buckets for OptimaTrade so your SRE can monitor in near-real time.
4) Credits: if after 30 days the evidence backfill shows p95 breaches outside of the probation carveout, we will apply a single-month service credit equal to 10% of that month’s hosted-inference usage for OptimaTrade. If you demonstrate remediation (via MAP) and agree to a phased rollback, no further credit will be necessary.
5) Next steps: please confirm receipt of the attachments and commit to the 5-business-day MAP delivery (we received the CSV and MAP draft). We'll prepare the addendum and circulate for signature.

If that looks good I'll have Contracts attach a short addendum to the existing order form.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
